events.question: What share of support tickets opened in October 2026 are still unresolved?

plan.headline: Share of tickets created in October 2026 that have no resolution date as of today, with a daily-created trend and a breakdown by category.

metrics.title: Unresolved ticket share
metrics.description: Tickets created in the selected period with no resolved_at, divided by all tickets created in that period. Tickets from test organizations are excluded when that assumption is on.

metrics.title: Unresolved share by category
metrics.description: For each ticket category, the share of tickets created in the selected period that are still unresolved, so you can see where the backlog is concentrated.

metrics.title: Unresolved share by creation week
metrics.description: For each week in the selected period, the share of tickets created that week that are still unresolved today. Older weeks should be mostly resolved, so high values there signal stuck tickets.

assumptions.label: Ticket open period
assumptions.rationale: The question asks about tickets opened in October 2026, so the period is set to that calendar month, inclusive of Oct 1 through Oct 31.

assumptions.label: Reporting timezone
assumptions.rationale: Ticket creation dates are bucketed in this timezone, so tickets near month boundaries fall into the right month. UTC is used because no company timezone is specified.

assumptions.label: Exclude test accounts
assumptions.rationale: The data dictionary says test, QA, demo and load-test tenants should be excluded from business metrics.

events.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.resolved_at IS NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS value FROM northwind.support_tickets t JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = t.org_id WHERE t.created_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text AND t.created_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)
events.explanation: Among tickets created in the selected period (in the chosen timezone, excluding test orgs if enabled), the percent with resolved_at NULL.

events.sql:
WITH tickets AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', t.created_at AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS week_start,
         t.resolved_at
  FROM northwind.support_tickets t
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = t.org_id
  WHERE t.created_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
    AND t.created_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
    AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)
)
SELECT (week_start)::date AS x,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NULL) / count(*), 1) AS y
FROM tickets
GROUP BY week_start
ORDER BY x
events.explanation: Buckets tickets created in the period (in the chosen timezone, test orgs optionally excluded) by week and computes the percent with no resolved_at.

events.sql: WITH tickets AS (SELECT t.category, t.resolved_at FROM northwind.support_tickets t JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = t.org_id WHERE t.created_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text AND t.created_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)) SELECT category AS label, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NULL) / count(*), 1) AS value FROM tickets GROUP BY category ORDER BY value DESC, label LIMIT 20
events.explanation: For tickets created in the selected period (in the chosen timezone, optionally excluding test orgs), computes per category the percent with NULL resolved_at.
